title: A standard core process for preparing work (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Now, this process we have just been through.

How to create a task and make sure it is in the feed. Is it clear to an agent?

I need to make sure that work should generally be prepared in a way that ensures it is not lost and is set up completely from the start. 

Are the steps clear?
Do tools exist for each step?
Can an agent attach work to domains, does it get routed to the right working groups?

We need a standard core process that is the default that pushes work through the same flow. We establish the essentials now and make sure it can be found, and then revee and refine with experience.
